items.name: Sausage, Egg & Cheese Hashbrown Bowl
items.description: Double order of hashbrowns topped with two slices of melted American cheese, two scrambled eggs, and two sausage patties.

items.name: Bacon, Egg & Cheese Hashbrown Bowl
